name: E-Commerce Platform
shortDescription: A modern e-commerce solution with real-time inventory management.
longDescription: Built a scalable e-commerce platform featuring real-time inventory tracking, secure payment processing, and an intuitive admin dashboard for managing products and orders.
research: Research focused on user shopping behaviors and cart abandonment reduction strategies.

name: Social Media Dashboard
shortDescription: Analytics dashboard for social media management.
longDescription: Designed and developed a comprehensive analytics dashboard that aggregates data from multiple social media platforms, providing insights and scheduling capabilities.
research: User research with social media managers to identify key metrics and workflows.

name: Fitness Tracker App
shortDescription: Mobile app for tracking workouts and nutrition.
longDescription: A comprehensive fitness application that helps users track their workouts, monitor nutrition, and achieve their health goals with personalized recommendations.
research: Conducted user interviews with fitness enthusiasts to understand tracking habits and motivations.

name: AI Customer Support Bot
shortDescription: Intelligent chatbot for customer service automation.
longDescription: Developed an AI-powered chatbot using natural language processing to handle customer inquiries, reducing response times and improving customer satisfaction.
research: Analysis of common customer support queries to train the AI model effectively.

name: Portfolio Builder
longDescription: Created an intuitive portfolio builder that allows creatives to showcase their work without coding knowledge, featuring customizable templates and hosting.
research: User testing with designers and photographers to refine the template customization flow.

name: Weather Forecast App
shortDescription: Real-time weather forecasting with interactive maps.
longDescription: Built a weather application with real-time updates, interactive radar maps, and severe weather alerts using multiple weather APIs for accurate forecasting.
research: Research on user preferences for weather data visualization and notification settings.
